traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Connection and value meet disruption and freedom. Attraction runs electric, sudden, and unattached to convention. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Erratic affections, sudden attractions and ruptures, and a refusal to be tied down. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for connection against disruption, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the connection/disruption form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Good for fresh, original creative and social moves; unreliable for steady commitments.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: A sudden change hurts differently when it exposes how much of your stability depended on somebody else remaining predictable.
readerCopy.body: A sudden change hurts differently when it exposes how much of your stability depended on somebody else remaining predictable. When Venus squares Uranus, a shift in another person’s feelings, availability, money, plans, or commitment can disrupt the arrangement you had quietly built your own sense of stability around. You may want the old terms back simply because you knew how to live inside them, even if they were already becoming restrictive. Let the disruption show you what you need to build for yourself so your ability to feel grounded is not entirely dependent on someone else staying the same.
